stance_rationale: The package is not production-auditable: it converts a full-sample/static 4-sleeve allocation into a repeated monthly schedule, exceeds the method-shopping cap, and lacks required stock-level, covariance, and infeasibility artifacts. The selected S4 claim may be a reasonable hypothesis, but it is not a QEPM-compliant optimizer handoff under AX-002 and RF-O9.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: Score sort then SR_window tie-breaker; selected S4_strict despite selected net_IR=-1.3217 and best reported net_IR=-1.2560 for MVO_lambda1/2/5.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: Reported 3bps uses assumed 10% sleeve drift, while weights.csv has one repeated vector and zero schedule turnover; underlying STR_1715 and TSMOM turnover/cost are not measured.

hard_constraint_violations: RF-O6: observed sleeve max_w=0.50 exceeds the base hard weight bound 0.20 if weights.csv is the optimizer weight file.
R2-C/RF-O10: candidates_tried=19 exceeds the <=10 candidate cap.
Required qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-P20260509_001/weights.csv and qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-P20260509_001 covariance/alpha artifacts are absent.

critical_concerns.description: weights.csv has 255 dates but only one unique weight vector; the package also admits 'Walk-forward rolling weights X' and derives weights from the 2015-2026 window before stamping them across 2005-2026. This is static in-sample allocation, not monthly walk-forward re-optimization.

Method shopping violates the <=10 candidate cap with 19 candidates, then selects by a custom AX/SR score instead of net_IR. Every non-baseline net_IR is negative and the selected S4_strict is not the best net_IR method.

The package silently changes optimizer bounds to [0, 0.50] at sleeve level while the base hard constraint is [0, 0.20] per name. No expanded stock-level weights are supplied, so max_names<=20, per-name cap, and ADV>=2e8 KRW cannot be independently verified.

The required stage A artifact directory and covariance.parquet are missing. The available covariance CSV is PSD but singular because Cash has zero variance, giving infinite full condition number, not the requested post-shrink cond<=100 evidence.

CVaR_LP_a95 is not a true CVaR LP in the run; the code falls back to a lower-tail-variance QP proxy when no LP solver is available, yet infeasibility_report is null and no optimizer_challenge_note exists.

Cost is not internalized from realized turnover. The package assigns the same 3bps drag using assumed 10% sleeve drift while the emitted schedule has zero changes and underlying stock/ETF turnover is not measured.

Sequential admission is not auditable: no TDC vs MEGA_05, no replacement-vs-integration metrics, no beta_port vs benchmark, and no overlay-OFF vs blended report are supplied for the PG2 upgrade decision.

The Tactical_Regime candidate is evaluated but no per-regime weight schedule, regime switch cost, CRISIS boundary shrink, or cash fallback is emitted, leaving the regime-conditional hypothesis unimplemented.

supporting_arguments: The inherited alpha_scores parquet itself is time-series shaped: 79,835 rows, Date x Ticker fields, 268 unique dates from 2004-01-01 to 2026-04-01, and 846 tickers.
The stage weights file sums to 1.0 on all 255 rows and is long-only at sleeve level.
S4_strict reports AX-001 v2 PASS with MDD relief, but that does not cure the process, artifact, cost, and method-shopping failures.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the 0.20 hard bound applies only to final stock names or also to the emitted optimizer weights; the package provides only sleeve weights.
Whether a strategic static allocation is allowed to override the QEPM walk-forward schedule requirement.
Whether a 2015-2026 TSMOM-window optimization may be applied to 2005-2014 dates without PIT leakage.
Whether the 2024-01 to 2026-04 lockbox/OOS sample was used for selection rather than only reporting.
Whether the covariance used for optimization is acceptable without shrinkage proof and with singular cash variance.
weakest_assumption: A full-sample or 2015-window-derived static 50/25/20/5 sleeve vector can be repeated across 255 monthly dates and treated as a PIT walk-forward production weight schedule.
rebuttal_required: Emit long-schema weights.csv with as_of_date, ticker, weight, method_selected, and prove each date uses only prior alpha, universe, and covariance inputs.
Expand sleeve weights into final stock-level holdings to verify max_names<=20, per-name max_w<=0.20, long-only, liquidity, and ADV constraints.
Provide a <=10 pre-registered method_shopping_log with selection_objective=net_ir or a justified non-net_IR mandate before seeing results.
Provide covariance.parquet with shrinkage method, eigenvalues, PSD status, and condition number <=100 after shrinkage.
Issue optimizer_challenge_note.md and an infeasibility report for CVaR solver fallback and any constraint/bounds deviations.
Report realized turnover and 15bps one-way cost from the actual rebalance path, including underlying STR_1715 and TSMOM turnover.
rationalization_red_flags: Static-weight backtest ... strategic asset allocation으로 통상 정적 운용

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Optimizer self-certification plus a pending Codex critique cannot satisfy AX-008; Forge and Architect evidence are absent, and the requested stage artifacts for alpha/covariance are missing.

optimizer_specific_questions: Can this weights.csv be consumed as production weights when it is wide sleeve schema rather than as_of_date x ticker x weight x method_selected?
Why is RF-O9 not triggered when unique_weight_rows=1 and the package explicitly says walk-forward rolling weights were not done?
Why was S4 selected when net_IR is negative and not best, after R4 P3 asks for net_IR-aware selection?
Where is the true CVaR LP result or infeasibility report for the solver fallback?
Where are TDC vs MEGA_05, replacement/integration metrics, beta drift, and expanded stock-level hard-constraint audits?
